text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired: service=embed-canary, severity=HIGH, symptom=5xx spike on /v1/embeddings (canary). p99 error rate 12% over last 3m. link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/INC-71987 :rotating_light:
pd-bot: Incident INC-71987 created and routed to #incidents and @sre-oncall. Assigned to sre-oncall-jess.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for release v2.3.1-canary (sha=abc1234) at 7198765400 — route: embed-model-variant:BETA.
sre-oncall-jess: ack — looking. anyone still on call from infra? @kevin?
kevin: on it, pulling quick dashboards. seeing spike in 5xx and a tail of tokenizer errors in logs: "InvalidTokenSequence".
julie: product ping — are customers seeing 5xx or degraded embeddings? support triage shows a handful of error reports for high-volume private customers.
raj: support: noticed error spike ~7198765380, ~2.1% of total embedding requests are 5xx globally; customers A and C reporting failures on bulk upload jobs.
alice: timeline check — canary deploy started ~7198765400 per deploy-bot. possible correlation.
kevin: digging into pod logs for canary pods. snippets:
```
ERROR embed.pipeline tokenization failed: InvalidTokenSequence at tokenizer/normalizer.go:112
stack: embed.pipeline -> tokenizer -> encoder
request_id=req-7f3a
```
kevin: also seeing higher tail latency before the errors spike — looks like bad tokenization triggers a panic path in the new tokenizer runtime (was updated in this build).
sre-oncall-jess: good find. next steps: (1) divert traffic off canary to stable, (2) scale down canary replicas, (3) rollback canary image if needed. I'll take (1) and (2) now.
sre-oncall-jess: setting canary traffic to 0% via traffic-split policy.
kevin: running command:
```
# set canary weight to 0
redwoodctl traffic split set --route /v1/embeddings --model embed-canary --weight 0
kubectl -n inference rollout pause deployment/embed-canary
```
kevin: traffic split command returned OK. monitoring now.
raj: support notified affected customers with a brief note: "We're investigating intermittent embedding errors; mitigation in progress."
julie: product asks for immediate temporary mitigation to avoid customer-visible errors — if diversion works, we'll keep stable route until root cause fixed.
sre-oncall-jess: canary replicas scaled down to 0. watch dashboards.
deploy-bot: Canary pods termination observed: embed-canary-5, embed-canary-6 terminated at 7198765532.
kevin: graphs show error rate dropping to baseline ~7198765560. p99 error back to normal.
pd-bot: INC-71987 updated: mitigation in progress, assigned to sre-oncall-jess, status=acknowledged.
alice: quick postmortem note — tokenizer library v0.9.2 was included in this canary. it introduced a stricter normalization step that rejects certain legacy byte sequences, causing InvalidTokenSequence and a panic path in embed pipeline.
sre-oncall-jess: agreed. immediate rollback plan: roll canary image back and create hotfix branch for tokenizer. but since traffic is diverted, we can keep stable while devs prepare fix.
kevin: rolling back canary image to previous stable for safety:
```
kubectl -n inference set image deployment/embed-canary embed=embed-service:v2.3.0
kubectl -n inference rollout status deployment/embed-canary
```
kevin: rollback completed and pods running v2.3.0 again.
julie: product: will notify customers that we diverted traffic and rolled back the canary; impact estimated: 2-3% of requests over 12 minutes, affected customers had bulk job failures — we offered retries.
raj: support: updating customer tickets and marking as mitigated for now.
sre-oncall-jess: closing incident in PagerDuty after we confirm stable. waiting 10m for regression.
pd-bot: INC-71987 status changed to "Under control" by sre-oncall-jess.
kevin: logs post-rollback show no InvalidTokenSequence and error rate stable.
alice: assigning postmortem owner: alice. will draft root cause and timeline; include action items: revert tokenizer change from v0.9.2, add unit tests for legacy byte sequences, add canary-level synthetic tests for bulk-upload flows.
julie: will prepare customer comms for affected accounts, include RCA once postmortem ready.
sre-oncall-jess: thanks team. tagging for follow up: @alice @kevin @julie @raj — please add notes to the incident doc and I'll link in PagerDuty. :white_check_mark: 
pd-bot: Incident INC-71987 resolved by sre-oncall-jess at 7198765801.
incident-bot: system note — create postmortem ticket: PMT-71987 and assign to alice.
alice: noted. I'll start the draft and loop in tokenizer owner @kevin.
kevin: will prepare a repro and cherry-pick fix to a hotfix branch.
julie: thanks everyone — great coordination.
